entities.name: Bautista Álvarez
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Bautista Goyel Álvarez Domínguez was a Galician nationalist politician and historian. He was born in San Amaro, Spain. Álvarez, who was a founding member of the Galician People's Union in 1964, also served as the Galician political party's President from 1964 through 1977.
